name: io.github.tonyyang0504/walmart-mcp
description: Walmart Marketplace (ecommerce channels): me, list_orders, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listin

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WALMART_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Walmart Marketplace API Client ID (Seller Center > Settings > API Key Management / Developer Portal, production keys).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WALMART_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The matching Client Secret; sent only as HTTP Basic to POST /v3/token, which returns a 15-minute access token sent as WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WALMART_SHIP_NODE
environmentVariables.description: shipNode id for set_inventory when you have several ship nodes; empty = your default ship node.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WALMART_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = https://sandbox.walmartapis.com; sandbox_dynamic = https://sandbox.walmartapis.com. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_WALMART_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.
